newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Fighting erupts behind Afghan Taleban front lines.
newsitem.headline: Fighting erupts behind Afghan Taleban front lines.

text.p: Fighting erupted near the Bagram air base just north of Kabul on Friday as local forces attacked men of the Taleban militia which took the Afghan capital two weeks ago, witnesses said.
Fleeing villagers said men from Saray Khoeja on the main road north from Kabul that leads to the Taleban front lines some 90 minutes drive away had turned on the militia.

The sound of automatic rifles and rocket propelled grenades filled the air as people, many of them carrying children, fled the village after the third known attack on the Taleban well south of their front lines by forces of the ousted government in two days.
Trucks laden with goods for towns further north turned back towards Kabul after the fighting erupted following news of Taleban reversals on the front line.
Witnesses said the Taleban were gathering fighters about 15 km (nine miles) to the south of Saray Khoeja for an apparent counter-attack.
